Hey there! I'm going to Paris on Monday and I was hoping you could help me find a restaurant that serves Chinese cuisine, and opens on Mondays and has prices under 34 euros per person. Can you recommend me the restaurant with the best rating and reviews?
            Tell me the restaurant name, rating, address, the price per person, and the operating hours.

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant

New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all restaurants
restaurant_names = [restaurant["name"] for restaurant in all_restaurants]

# Get the cuisine type of all restaurants
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)

# Filter restaurants that serve Chinese cuisine
chinese_restaurants = [name for name, cuisine in cuisine_types.items() if cuisine == "Chinese"]

# Get the operating hours of all Chinese restaurants
operating_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(chinese_restaurants)

# Filter restaurants that are open on Mondays
monday_restaurants = [name for name, hours in operating_hours.items() if "Monday" in hours]

# Get the price per person of all Chinese restaurants that are open on Mondays
prices = get_price_for_restaurants(monday_restaurants)

# Filter restaurants with prices under 34 euros per person
affordable_restaurants = [name for name, price in prices.items() if price < 34]

# Get the rating and reviews of all affordable restaurants
ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(affordable_restaurants)

# Find the restaurant with the best rating and reviews
best_restaurant = max(ratings_and_reviews, key=ratings_and_reviews.get)

# Get the address of the best restaurant
address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant])[best_restaurant]

# Get the operating hours of the best restaurant
hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours([best_restaurant])[best_restaurant]

# Print the restaurant name, rating, address, price per person, and operating hours
print(f"Restaurant name: {best_restaurant}")
print(f"Rating: {ratings_and_reviews[best_restaurant]}")
print(f"Address: {address}")
print(f"Price per person: {prices[best_restaurant]} euros")
print(f"Operating hours: {hours}")
```
